answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the thread of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the spiral of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the knoll re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
